text:
The plate is probably a dinner plate, about 24-26 cm across. The food on it is hash browns topped with salsa verde and pico de gallo, plus about 3 strips of bacon.

Hash browns: the pile covers roughly half the plate and is fairly thin. I estimate about 120 g. Cooked with oil, that is roughly 1.5 kcal/g, so about 180 kcal.

Salsa and pico: about 40 g, around 15 kcal.

Bacon: about 3 strips, roughly 8 g each cooked, so about 24 g. At about 5 kcal/g that is around 120 kcal. The strips look a bit thick, so I'll use 4 strips' worth, about 30 g and 150 kcal.

Total mass is about 120 + 40 + 30 = 190 g. Total energy is about 180 + 15 + 150 = 345 kcal. Allowing for the oil in the hash browns, I'll round up to about 360 kcal.
